activateModule(address,uint8).details: Only governance (ROLE_TIMELOCK) can activate modules directly.      Ensures the escrow contract is registered.      Reverts if no module is queued for the given type, or if the ETA has not passed yet.      Enforces 7-day slow lane delay - cannot be bypassed.

constructor.details: Grants `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and `ROLE_TIMELOCK` to `initialAdmin` for initial setup.      In production, `ROLE_TIMELOCK` should be held by the TimelockController.

params.initialAdmin: Initial admin for bootstrap (expected to be replaced/managed by governance wiring).

getModule(address,uint8).details: PRIORITY: Consolidated getter to reduce bytecode in escrow contracts

returns._0: The module address (address(0) if not set)

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

queueModule(address,uint8,address).details: Only governance (ROLE_TIMELOCK) can queue modules directly.      Ensures the escrow contract is registered.      Enforces 7-day slow lane delay via SlowLaneQueueActivate.      For yield modules, prevents assignment if already assigned to another escrow.

params.module: Address of the new module to queue

registerEscrowContract(address).details: Only ROLE_TIMELOCK can register escrow contracts (governance-controlled)

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

escrowModuleStates(address).notice: Mapping from escrow contract to its module state

getDefaultCancellationStrategy(address).notice: Get default cancellation strategy for an escrow contract

getDefaultReleaseStrategy(address).notice: Get default release strategy for an escrow contract

getDefaultResolutionModule(address).notice: Get default resolution module for an escrow contract

getDefaultYieldDistributionModule(addres.notice: Get default yield distribution module for an escrow contract

getDefaultYieldGenerationModule(address).notice: Get default yield generation module for an escrow contract

getModule(address,uint8).notice: Get module address for an escrow contract by type

registerEscrowContract(address).notice: Register an escrow contract for module management

setDefaultCancellationStrategy(address,a.notice: Set the default cancellation strategy for an escrow contract

yieldDistributionModuleToEscrow(address).notice: Mapping from yield distribution module to its assigned escrow contract

yieldGenerationModuleToEscrow(address).notice: Mapping from yield generation module to its assigned escrow contract
